NIKA / Windows install

1. Unzip this archive. You'll see a folder called NIKA.vst3.

2. Drag the NIKA.vst3 folder into:
   C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\

   Windows will ask for administrator permission. Click Yes.

3. Open your DAW (Ableton, FL, Reaper, etc.) and rescan plug-ins
   if it doesn't pick up NIKA automatically.

—

NIKA's Windows build is not code-signed. If you see any
"unrecognised app" warning at any point, click "More info"
then "Run anyway".

Need help? hello@nikkivst.com
